title: an array or map literal selects the overload that takes a collection
purpose: When several signatures fit a call's form, an array or map literal argument is typed by the only parameter that takes a collection; a named call never selects a variadic signature (#501).

provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.8 and Book 17.4: a role-typed array parameter types a heterogeneous literal; variadic calls are positional-only.
